title: manager plan · Advance to researcher. The plan is feasible: inspect 4 sources on benc
summary: Advance to researcher. The plan is feasible: inspect 4 sources on benchmark metrics under fixed budgets, explicitly noting missing baselines. This gathers descriptive evidence without violating the research-only constraint.
body:
The previous loop failed because it demanded controlled A/B comparisons (dynamic vs. static) under identical token budgets, a condition no existing study satisfies. The literature lacks these specific experimental controls. 

This revised plan pivots to gathering descriptive evidence. We will inspect 4 sources reporting task success and hallucination rates on standard benchmarks (e.g., ScienceWorld, BigBench) under fixed token budgets. Crucially, we must explicitly document where direct baseline comparisons are absent. This builds the necessary evidence base for future causal claims without forcing a fit to unavailable data. Limit to 4 sources; do not implement code.
